title: Fix AI chat object visibility by bridging SchemaRegistry to metadata service
body:
AI chat in Studio reported zero objects despite system objects existing in the kernel. The root cause: objects in SchemaRegistry (from both `sys_metadata` database and plugin registrations) were invisible to `IMetadataService.listObjects()`, which the AI tools query.

## Changes

**ObjectQLPlugin.bridgeObjectsToMetadataService()** - New dedicated method that bridges ALL SchemaRegistry objects:
- Runs after `syncRegisteredSchemas()` at the end of `ObjectQLPlugin.start()`
- Iterates all SchemaRegistry objects via `getAllObjects()`
- Checks `metadataService.getObject()` to prevent duplicates
- Registers missing objects with `metadataService.register('object', ...)`
- Logs bridged count and total for observability

**ObjectQLPlugin.restoreMetadataFromDb()** - Simplified to only handle DB restoration:
- Removed conditional bridging logic that only ran when `loaded > 0`
- DB restoration now focuses solely on loading from `sys_metadata` into SchemaRegistry

## Architecture

Two separate registries existed:
- **SchemaRegistry** (ObjectQL) ← `sys_metadata` database records + plugin-registered objects
- **MetadataManager** (metadata service) ← filesystem `.ts`/`.yaml` definitions

AI tools query the metadata service, which had no visibility into SchemaRegistry objects. The bridge ensures all sources are queryable via `IMetadataService`.

## Key Fix

The original implementation only bridged objects when they were loaded from the database (`if (loaded > 0)`), missing objects registered by plugins during `init()` phase (like `sys_user`, `sys_session`, etc.). The new approach bridges ALL objects regardless of source.

```typescript
// After all objects are registered and schemas synced
const objects = this.ql.registry.getAllObjects();
for (const obj of objects) {
  const existing = await metadataService.getObject(obj.name);
  if (!existing) {
    await metadataService.register('object', obj.name, obj);
  }
}
```

Gracefully degrades if metadata service unavailable. Execution order ensures filesystem objects load first (MetadataPlugin.start), then all SchemaRegistry objects bridge (ObjectQLPlugin.start).
